description_en: Deletes an Express Connect failover test job by calling the DeleteFailoverTestJob operation
description_zh: 调用DeleteFailoverTestJob接口删除高速通道故障演练任务
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-failover-test-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id ftj-bp1yh6mvi13aq3g8w0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteFailoverTestJob

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the failover test job. 

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the failover test job. This ID is returned by the CreateFailoverTestJob operation and can also be obtained by calling DescribeFailoverTestJobs. You cannot construct this value manually
parameters.help_zh: 故障演练任务ID，由CreateFailoverTestJob接口返回，也可通过DescribeFailoverTestJobs查询获取，不支持自行拼装
parameters.name: job_id
